# palmy video — subtitles, playback speed and chapters.
#
# The clip, its sidecar .srt, its embedded subtitle stream and its five
# chapters are all generated by demo-run.sh with ffmpeg lavfi. Nothing here
# touches the user's media, camera or microphone.
#
# The opening wait is long on purpose. The player spends its first couple of
# seconds starting two ffmpeg processes and pw-cat, and re-opens the pipeline
# once more when the window settles at its final size; a key pressed into that
# is a key that may not arrive. Nothing here is urgent enough to risk it.
wait 5.0

# The sidecar was found on open and is already on the picture. Let it play.
wait 4.0

# The track list, and a cycle onto the embedded stream.
key t
wait 2.6
key c
wait 3.0
key c
wait 2.0
key c
wait 2.2
key t
wait 1.4

# Speed: up to 2x in quarters, then back down past 1x to 0.5x, then reset.
key bracketright
wait 1.6
key bracketright
wait 1.6
key bracketright
wait 1.6
key bracketright
wait 2.4
key backslash
wait 2.0
key bracketleft
wait 1.4
key bracketleft
wait 2.6
key backslash
wait 1.6

# Chapters: back to the start, then forward through them, then back one.
key Home
wait 2.0
key Next
wait 2.1
key Next
wait 2.1
key Next
wait 2.1
key Prior
wait 2.1

# Hide and show the subtitles, and the pipeline numbers.
key v
wait 1.6
key v
wait 1.8
key s
wait 2.6
key s
wait 1.2

# Back to the library this demo built for itself.
key Escape
wait 3.0
